subject.title: fix(qa-channel): honor canonical thread action fields

question: Should the published `qaChannelMessageActions` adapter officially prefer canonical `target`/`threadName`/`message` values whenever callers also provide its shipped legacy aliases?
rationale: The code preserves aliases and tests the precedence rule, but choosing the permanent behavior for conflicting public inputs is an ownership and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical defect.

options.title: Accept canonical-first precedence
options.body: Confirm the shared message-action fields are authoritative and merge with the retained aliases and focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Preserve legacy-first collisions
options.body: Require the adapter to use legacy values when both forms are supplied, then update the tests and implementation accordingly.

options.title: Pause for a broader adapter contract decision
options.body: Keep the PR open if QA action adapters need a repository-wide collision-policy standard before this surface can merge.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical-first precedence
recommendation.body: Confirm the shared message-action fields are authoritative and merge with the retained aliases and focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only person concretely connected to the proposed adapter contract in the supplied evidence; current-main history attribution was unavailable.
